whoItsFor: Developers who want to run large fleets of AI agents cheaply on small servers or embed an agent harness in Rust, and desktop users who want a local agent app with memory, browser and desktop control, and voice.
useCases: Run hundreds of agents side by side on a small VPS
Use a desktop agent app with built-in memory, browser control, and voice
Embed an agent in your own Rust code as a library
